title: Followed his father meekly about the city from bar to bar
html_source:
Stephen followed him “meekly” because he viewed the event of going from bar to bar as pathetic. It was embarrassing to Stephen that his own father was so easily entertained by simply getting drunk.

I don’t think he will be getting his father one of these.
